responsibility: Defines the HSA/ELF assembler and driver configuration for AMD GCN offload code generation. It overrides generic asm-output macros for LLVM’s AMDGPU assembler syntax and alignment rules, selects sections, labels, symbol formatting, debug-register mapping, and startup specs, and sets ASM_SPEC/LINK_SPEC fragments that translate GCC options such as -march, -mxnack, and -msram-ecc into the HSA code-object and LLVM assembler options used to produce GCN device objects.
